readmeExcerpt: PyQuil is a Python library for quantum programming using Quil, the quantum instruction language developed at Rigetti Computing. PyQuil serves three main functions: Easily generating Quil programs from quantum gates and classical operations Compiling and simulating Quil programs using the Quil Compiler (quilc) and the Quantum Virtual Machine (QVM) Executing Quil programs on real quantum processors (QPUs) using [Quantum Cloud Services][qcs-paper] (QCS)
